units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 24:14">Targ. Y. II, Num. XXIV, 14</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 15; a. e.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:8">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>ועייץ לו עצות וכ׳</he> and is likely to give him bad advice.
<cite ref="Yevamot 107a:10">Yeb. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>עָיְיצֵי לה וכ׳</he> her relatives may advise her (put her up to it) and take the property away from me.
